test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correctly spelt words.**

options.text: What was the begining of the dispute?
There is no comparision between the two books.
I got selected in D category.

solution: The correct answer is **"I got selected in D category."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Option 4 is the only sentence that has all words spelled correctly. • The words **"selected"** and** "category" **are** **spelled correctly. • **Selected**: carefully choose as being the best or most suitable. (सर्वोत्तम या सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त का चयन सावधानी से करें) • Category: a class or division of people or things regarded as having particular shared characteristics. (लोगों या चीज़ों का एक वर्ग या विभाजन जिसे विशेष साझा विशेषताओं वाला माना जाता है) • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • The word "beginning" is misspelled in option 1. It should be spelled with two "n"s. • The word "comparison" is misspelled in option 2. It should be spelled with one "r" and two "s"s. • The word "handled" is misspelled in option 3. It should be spelled with one "l" and one "d." 1b9:Tafd, The correct answer is **"blissful."**
